audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 4 read 'Skill' in the full layer and 'Ziggs' in the content layer — four rows rendering two different answers on one page.
audit.why: Content agrees with the packet levelChart, and the kits agree with content: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 against Breath of Light's 750 and returns every 4-6s, Hexplosive Minefield covers 900 on a flat 16s, and Satchel Charge knocks Aurelion Sol away while dealing Ziggs himself no damage. There is no level between 2 and 6 where Aurelion Sol has the better tool.
audit.corrected: Full-layer rows 1-4 moved Skill -> Ziggs as one atomic group with the packet, and all four whys rewritten in the same proposal so each sentence argues for Ziggs.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Starsurge', 'Voice of Light' and 'Comet of the Legend' were used across spikes and prose, and a 'Q stun' was promised three times.
audit.why: None of those are current Aurelion Sol abilities. His Q is Breath of Light, a channelled beam with no stun; his only stun is Falling Star at 100-120s.
audit.corrected: All replaced with the real abilities and the real first-item spike (Rod of Ages health letting you hold ground inside his poke).

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] described Mega Inferno Bomb under the Level 3 row, and whys[4] claimed 'your ult is too slow to punish him' without any source.
audit.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is a level 6 ability. The real reason you cannot answer it is range: 5000 against Falling Star's 1250 — a number, not a speed claim.
audit.corrected: whys[2] re-pointed at Hexplosive Minefield, which is what actually beats you at level 3; whys[4] and content mid now cite the two ranges.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the packet flagged zero sequencing cues anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Real numbers: Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16, Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70 at 5000 range.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around those, with the explicit 'he is only catchable while Satchel Charge is down' sequencing line kept but now tied to its real 12-20s window.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were other fields' strings under unrelated titles; dontsFull[0].d, ahead, breakdown.carry and breakdown.feeding were name-swap templates.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed and the template sweep.
audit.corrected: All eight rewritten from Ziggs' kit at the same length.

edits.after: Ziggs

edits.before: Still farming. Drag the Q beam across his face only when he steps onto your caster minions — every champion tick is permanent stacks.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 to your 750 and costs him 55 mana — he pokes from a step you cannot reach, so take the CS and give ground.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ziggs

edits.before: E online: drop the black hole ON the wave and Q the pull — your first real clear pattern, and every execute tick stacks stardust.
edits.after: The black hole clears the wave, but Hexplosive Minefield is 16s of 900-range slow that keeps you standing exactly where his bomb lands.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ziggs

edits.before: W lets you Q while flying — the burn-flyby trade is real now. In-and-out: never land inside his engage range.
edits.after: Astral Flight lets you Q while flying, but 22s of cooldown against a 12s Satchel Charge is not a trade you can repeat.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ziggs

edits.before: Falling Star online — the self-peel stun your kit was missing. With R up, his dive math suddenly has a second variable.
edits.after: Falling Star is online, but Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 and he never even has to be near the fight to use it.

edits.before: Ziggs' bomb range outclasses your Starsurge windup, letting him poke freely
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 against your 750, letting him poke for free

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb's huge threat radius and burst dominate any contested space
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield slows you off the wave every 16 seconds from 900 range

edits.before: His zone control keeps denying farm and vision since your answer isn't online yet
edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you away and takes no damage doing it, so he escapes free

edits.before: His ultimate still threatens burst on groups while your ult is too slow to punish him
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000, so he never has to stand where you can answer

edits.before: Your first item gives you the range and stun to start trading evenly with his bombs
edits.after: Rod of Ages health lets you eat a Bouncing Bomb and keep the beam burning on him

edits.before: Ziggs out-ranges your Starsurge with Bouncing Bomb and Satchel Charge poke, chunking your wave-clear HP before you can walk your Q into range.
edits.after: Ziggs out-ranges you 850 to 750 with Bouncing Bomb and lays Hexplosive Minefield across your approach, chunking you before the beam is ever in range.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb zones an entire section of lane and threatens massive burst on anyone caught in it, and it out-ranges anything you can punish it with.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb hurls 5000 units, zoning a whole section of lane and threatening massive burst on anyone caught in the primary blast — nothing you own reaches back.

edits.before: Once you have range/AP from your first item, your Q stun and Voice of Light poke start trading favorably against his Bouncing Bomb harass.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages gives you the health to hold ground, the black hole and a stacked beam start trading favourably against his Bouncing Bomb harass.

edits.before: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb outranges your Starsurge windup entirely, letting him poke you down across the wave while staying safe behind minions. Levels 1-5 you're mostly farming under tower and eating chip damage, since walking up to threaten a Q stun just eats more bomb bounces and Satchel Charge knockback punishment.
edits.after: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb outranges your beam 850 to 750, letting him poke you down across the wave while staying safe behind minions. Levels 1-5 you are farming under tower and eating chip damage, since walking up just feeds more bomb bounces and a Hexplosive Minefield slow onto the path you came in on.

edits.before: Level 6 is brutal — Mega Inferno Bomb threatens huge burst over a massive area, punishing you for grouping on the wave or standing on jungle camps, and its range means you can't answer it with your own Comet of the Legend in time. Play passive, spread out, and just survive to your first back.
edits.after: Level 6 is brutal — Mega Inferno Bomb threatens huge burst over a massive area from 5000 range, punishing you for grouping on the wave or standing on jungle camps, and Falling Star's 1250 range means you can never answer it in kind. Play passive, spread out, and survive to your first back.

edits.before: Once you have your first item, your Q stun finally starts landing on his repositions and your Voice of Light poke trades evenly with his bombs, and by full build your ultimate's teamfight presence outscales a Ziggs who has to play a careful kiting game to stay alive. Group as a team where his AoE is less decisive and let your scaling take over.
edits.after: Once you have your first item, Falling Star finally starts landing on his repositions and a stacked beam trades evenly with his bombs, and by full build The Skies Descend outscales a Ziggs who has to play a careful kiting game to stay alive. Group as a team where his AoE is less decisive and let your scaling take over.

edits.before: Play for scaling — his poke stops mattering once your stun lands consistently
edits.after: Play for scaling — his poke stops mattering once Rod of Ages is finished

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by out-ranging you 850 to 750 and knocking himself out of every single fight with Satchel Charge.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Astral Flight spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5 — it knocks him away and deals him no damage, so he is only catchable while it is down. - Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s. - Bouncing Bomb is 4-6s, so the poke never really stops.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by closing the distance he needs: Ziggs has one knockback on a 12-20s timer, and once Satchel Charge is spent there is nothing between you.

edits.before: If Ziggs opens the score, reset expectations and respect Satchel Charge doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Ziggs opens the score his poke never stops, so stop contesting the wave at all: clear the back line with E from 750 and let his 16s minefield expire on empty ground behind you.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Ziggs on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, close the gap he cannot make: shove with E executes, walk at him the moment Satchel Charge is down, and take the plates his range was supposed to buy him.

edits.before: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Every second the breath holds on Ziggs is permanent Stardust, and at 3s cooldown it costs you nothing to restart.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Ziggs for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: The black hole clears the back line from 750 and its centre executes what survives, so the wave dies without you walking into bomb range.

edits.before: That is Ziggs’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Trading early just feeds a Bouncing Bomb every 4 seconds.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield slows you mid-channel from 900, and the next bomb is already in the air.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and Satchel Charge knocks you back out of it — you spend the whole escape and gain nothing.

notes: Audited on the brief's games=128 (MC_REAL_GAMES), not deferred. One supplied missing-interaction was NOT written: 'Ziggs bypasses stacking resistances (Satchel Charge)' comes from a percentHealth flag on his W, but Riot's Satchel Charge text describes knockback damage and turret hexploding with no percent-health component anywhere. That looks like a tooltip-parse misfire, and telling a reader armour and MR are the wrong answer on that basis would be an invented mechanic — recorded here instead. Chart rows 1-4 moved Skill -> Ziggs in the full layer to match content and the packet, with all four whys rewritten in the same proposal (the old whys argued for Aurelion Sol under rows the page was about to label Ziggs). Fabricated abilities removed: 'Starsurge', 'Voice of Light', 'Comet of the Legend', plus a 'Q stun' cited three times that his kit does not have. whys[2] had Mega Inferno Bomb — a level 6 ability — under the Level 3 row. Ziggs is male per champ-gender.
